name: prime-agent-self-upgrade
description: Evaluates whether Prime Agent corrections become durable, auditable Agent OS lessons with explicit quality gates.

criteria.description: The run starts in a low-stakes or reversible workspace.
A useful correction is saved through /refine and mirrored into Agent OS memory or skill learnings.
The run defines objective quality gates before autonomous work continues.
Saved lessons are ready for weekly notebook review and rollback if needed.
